senses.gloss: to turn (act. a. neut.) also to turn around, to flee; to make turn around, to beat.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 78:9">Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 9</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 8:13">Targ. I Chron. VIII, 13</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:10">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ</cite> top <he>אפיך אפיך</he> turn around, turn around.
<cite ref="Menachot 25b">Men. 25ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>איפוך</he> reverse it, or, I reverse it.
Ib. ומי מצית אפכת לה how can you reverse it? Gitt. 69ᵇ ונַפְּכֵיה let him reverse it; a. fr.—(With שבועה) to reverse the oath, shift the oath over to the opponent.
<cite ref="Shevuot 41a">Shebu. 41ᵃ</cite> in a case where the Biblical law prescribes an oath <he>לא מַפְכִינָן</he> we allow it not to be shifted over to the claimant; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 31a:5">Sabb. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>אפיך ליה</he> he reversed it, i.e. recited the alphabet to him in inverted order.
<cite ref="Yevamot 63a:13">Yeb. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ לה</he> he said to her just the reverse.
<cite ref="Gittin 67b:16">Gitt. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>מֵיפַךְ אפכי</he> they will do the reverse; a. fr.
<cite ref="Taanit 25a:12">Taan. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>דאפכיה לעלמא מרישא</he> (Ms. M. <he>דאחרב</he>) that I should destroy the world.

senses.gloss: (cmp. אִיכְפַּת) to have to do with, care for, mind.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:1:10">Y. Bets. I, 60ᵃ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 9:1:8">Y. Shebi. IX, 38ᶜ</cite> top; Y. Erub. III, 21ᵇ bot. (read:) <he>מה אפך לן פתילה גבי וכ׳</he> what does the law about wicks concern us when speaking of the egg, i.e. what relation is there between the two? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:32">Y. Ter. VIII, 46ᵃ</cite> top <he>מה אפך לן מִצְוֹת וכ׳</he> what relation is there between religious laws and sanitary precautions concerning snake-bitten fruit? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:32">Ib.</cite> <he>מה אפכיי וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 31b:3">Ab. Zar. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>כ״ע אפכי</he> all the people are about, on the road.

senses.gloss: to pay in return, to retaliate, v. הֲפַךְ a. אַפּוּכִי.

units: <cite ref="Beitzah 10b">Bets. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>איתפוכי אתפך</he> (old ed. correctly <he>אתְּפוּךְ</he>, mod. ed. <he>אתהפוכי אתהפוך</he>, Ms. M. <he>והפוכי</he>) they changed places. Deriv. <cite ref="A02619"><he>אַפּוּכִי</he></cite>, <cite ref="A01553"><he>אִיפְּכָא</he></cite>.
